name: Corrupted Ranger Thane
description: Once a stalwart guardian of the Northern Corrupted Woods, the Corrupted Ranger Thane now stands as a tragic monument to Malarok's insidious influence. His once-pristine ranger's leather armor is marred with dark, oozing fissures from which faint wisps of necrotic energy seep like smoke. His gaunt face, shadowed beneath a tattered hood, reveals sunken eyes glowing dimly with a sickly green light, flickering between lucidity and torment. Jagged, blackened thorns have pierced through his flesh in places, entwining with sinew and bone, while patches of bark-like skin crackle with corrupted magic along his arms and neck. His quiver holds arrows tipped with a strange, pulsing black resin, seemingly alive and dripping with a corrosive substance. Despite the corruption ravaging his body and mind, Thane moves with a tense, predatory grace, his breath ragged as he occasionally warns intruders of the creeping doom with a voice hoarse but laced with desperate clarity. Beside him, his once-loyal wolf companion has been twisted into a savage shadow of its former self, snarling and snapping as it prowls erratically. A palpable aura of sorrow and menace clings to Thane, the air around him heavy with the stench of decayed earth and wild magic gone awry, embodying the forest's tragic fall from grace.
